content: Smooth seas do not make skillful sailors.
author: African Proverbs
sourceWork: Bahari tulivu haifanyi baharia stadi — Swahili Coastal Adage
explanation: Anyone can sit at the helm when the water is glassy and the breeze is mild. But true mastery is forged in the gale, when waves break over the bow and the rudder shudders under fury. Do not pray for an easy voyage; pray for the grit to navigate tempestuous seas.
practicalInsight: When unexpected turbulence strikes your schedule or family today, welcome it as the sea that makes you a master sailor.
reflectionPrompt: What difficult trial are you currently facing that is secretly upgrading your resilience and wisdom?
